fields.description: The message text, exactly as it is replayed to the model.
fields.label: Content

fields.description: The addresses the attachments were stored under, as a JSON list. The bytes travel with the turn; this is what outlives it.
fields.label: Attachment URLs

fields.description: The text the attachments' contents held, as a JSON list parallel to the URLs. Stored so a reader who reloads the thread and asks a follow-up about the document is answered about it, rather than about a file nobody has read since.
fields.label: Attachment Texts
Truncated
fields.description: The provider cut this answer off at the token ceiling. The answer is unfinished, not wrong — and a reader who reloads the thread must still be told which of the two it is.
The tool this turn's result belongs to. Set on `tool` rows only.
fields.label: Tool

fields.description: Which tool round this turn belongs to. Round 0 is the first.
fields.label: Round

fields.description: The tool calls the model asked for, as a JSON array.
fields.label: Tool Calls

fields.description: The reader's rating of this answer, if they gave one. Blank means unrated.
fields.label: Rating

fields.description: The page the turn was asked from, as `view|doctype|name`. Context of the question, not of the thread: the transcript names it when the reader is reading the thread from somewhere else.
fields.label: Page Identity
